content:
nina: FYI found a regression after rolling the new int8 packaging for lumin. It only reproduces on inputs containing an Ideographic Variation Sequence (IVS) / variation selector. zh->ja BLEU fell ~1.9 on our locale mixset. Minimal repro + notes below.

oscar: can you paste the tiny repro?

nina: sure. run on lumin-int8 build:
```
$ printf '\u6f22\uDB40\uDD00\u5b57' | ./tok --model models/lumin-int8 | tr '\n' ' ' ; echo
# -> HAN, VS, HAN token sequence on int8
```
float tokenizer produced either a merged token or kept the VS invisible in the token stream; the int8 artifact emits VS as its own token id and detok inserts spacing.

pema: any practical example that breaks QA?

nina: small sentence from our testset: 
```
input: "\u65e5\u672c\u3067\u306f\u3000\u6f22\uDB40\uDD00\u5b57\u3092\u4f7f\u3044\u307e\u3059\u3002"
float decode: "\u65e5\u672c\u3067\u306f\u3000\u6f22\u5b57\u3092\u4f7f\u3044\u307e\u3059\u3002"
int8 decode:  "\u65e5\u672c\u3067\u306f\u3000\u6f22\uDB40\uDD00 \u5b57\u3092\u4f7f\u3044\u307e\u3059\u3002"
```
notice the inserted space after the preserved VS token which causes exact-match failures and lowers BLEU.

jun: quick guess: packaging remap introduced an explicit token for U+E0100, splitting a previously merged token. Did you inspect token_map?

nina: yep. token_map excerpt: 
```
# float vocab
"\u6f22\u5b57" -> id 12012
# int8 rebuilt
"\u6f22" -> 12012; "\uDB40\uDD00" -> 23001; "\u5b57" -> 12013
```
So the quant packaging changed the token boundaries.

pema: OK. candidate root causes: (A) sentencepiece retrain vs copy during packaging, (B) index remap / truncation logic that assigns new ids by frequency bin, (C) detok heuristics that treat VS/Cf codepoints as spacers when they appear as standalone tokens.

oscar: what's low-risk mitigation?

nina: short-term we can normalize IVS at the API edge for zh/ja canary routes (strip VS) and see metric delta. Long-term we should preserve multi-codepoint tokens that existed in float vocab during packaging.

ci-bot: nightly-regression: lumin-int8 vs float: BLEU 29.7 -> 27.8 (-1.9). Exact detok match 93.1% -> 88.6%.

jun: can we attempt a remap that forces the packaging to reuse float token ids for multi-codepoint entries? I can try a quick script to reassign indices and rebuild the int8 table.

pema: please also add IVS + ZWJ cases to the detok regression suite. I9ll add 16 tiny samples covering CJK + variation selectors + ZWJ combos.

jun: remap done locally; quick smoke shows detok parity on the small IVS set. Pushing artifact to staging: s3://redwood-staging/models/lumin-int8-remap-20260323.tar.gz

oscar: schedule canary: Canary A = lumin-int8 current, Canary B = lumin-int8 remap + no edge-normalize. We'll compare BLEU + token-exact metrics.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled for lumin-int8 -> canary-asia at 2026-03-23T04:10:00Z (rollout id r-2026-03-23-034).

pema: tests & packaging guard PR queued. The guard will run a tiny detok parity check for locale-targeted edge cases and fail packaging if detok mismatch > 0.5% on the set.

nina: quick canary update: initial results on 2k-sample subset: A BLEU=27.6, B BLEU=29.5, detok-exact B matches float for IVS samples. Remap looks good.

oscar: nice. think we should make the packaging guard mandatory and also add a step in model-onboarding checklist: "verify preservation of combined tokens for special codepoints (IVS/ZWJ)".

pema: agreed. also note downstream tasks that rely on VS must be considered — stripping VS at edge may be lossy. We'll avoid that unless customers request variant glyph fidelity.

jun: opened issue ML-8725 with repro artifacts + remap patch + canary logs. Adding links to s3 bundle and the small testcases. cc @nina @pema

nina: thanks all. once packaging guard PR merges we should re-release int8 artifacts that failed. I'll follow up in ML-8725 with rollout plan. :white_check_mark:
